working_memory.text: The disused Corran tram depot is to become a covered market, with the 1930s tiled mural of the tram route on the end wall kept and restored as its centrepiece. The building has stood empty since the last tram ran in 1954, apart from a spell as a bus garage. Traders will rent stalls by the day, and a bakery and a fishmonger have already signed up. The roof will be replaced with glass to bring light into the hall. Work starts in the new year.
